lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular array of high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible posterior to the fifth gill slit, organized into approximately four vertical columns with highest intensity in the mid-lateral zone.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible grid-like lattice across the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow gradient transition running parallel to the dorsal midline.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of smaller high-luminance spots, with spot diameter decreasing towards the distal edge of the fin.
